sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:57

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:57:1
items.html: Hochma nullifies the others, and then the three of them are nullified in the letter Yod: That is, that the level of Hochma includes within it all the remaining levels that are lower than it, as the ARI says above, page 316, item 34, and these are his words: “for it is a great rule in our hands that the upper one is greater than all that is below it.” And therefore every level is called only by the name of the highest Sefira in it.
